NOPE.api_views module¶

class NOPE.api_views.ArticleViewSet(**kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: ModelViewSet

API endpoint for articles. - GET /api/articles/ - List all approved public articles (or all approved if authenticated) - GET /api/articles/subscribed/ - Articles from subscribed publishers/journalists - GET /api/articles/<id>/ - Retrieve single article - POST /api/articles/ - Create article (journalists only) - PUT/PATCH /api/articles/<id>/ - Update article (editors/journalists) - DELETE /api/articles/<id>/ - Delete article (editors/journalists)

approve(request, pk=None)[source]¶

Approve an article (editors only). This triggers the signal that sends emails and posts to X.

get_queryset()[source]¶

Unauthenticated: Only public, approved articles Readers: All approved articles (public + private) Journalists: Their own articles + all approved ones Editors: All articles

perform_create(serializer)[source]¶

Automatically set the author to current user for journalists.

permission_classes = [<class 'NOPE.permissions.IsEditorOrJournalistOrReadOnly'>]¶
serializer_class¶

alias of ArticleSerializer

subscribed(request)[source]¶

Return articles from publishers/journalists that the reader is subscribed to. Only available for readers.

class NOPE.api_views.NewsletterViewSet(**kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: ModelViewSet

API endpoint for newsletters. Journalists and editors can create/edit newsletters. Readers can only view published newsletters.

get_queryset()[source]¶

Readers see only published newsletters. Journalists see their own + published. Editors see all.

NOPE.signals module¶

NOPE signals module.

Handles post-save signals for the Article model: notifies subscribers by email and posts to X (Twitter) when an article is approved and published.

NOPE.signals.handle_article_approval(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]¶

Fire email and X notifications when an article is freshly approved.

NOPE.views module¶

NOPE views module.

Handles all HTTP request/response logic for the News Outside Publishing Engine, including authentication, article management, publisher administration, reader subscriptions, and newsletter browsing.
